decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory tightly linked to the core trailer range, it remains worth keeping because it supports the installed base and ties up little capital even after the initial learning period.

After several years the firm should have learned enough about this more specialized trailer line, and if it has not become a clearly valuable part of the portfolio the resources are better redeployed to stronger core products and new development.
A low-bed trailer series fits the firm's core competence and customer base well, so its strategic fit and likely steady demand justify continued commitment.
This cover series complements existing trailer sales, strengthens the overall offer for dealers and end customers, and is relatively inexpensive to continue within the broader product system.
